# CabsCode

> Custom web application development and front-end engineering in Botswana by solo developer Tema Bown. Crafting fast, scalable digital experiences for local and international clients.

CabsCode is the personal portfolio and services site of Tema Bown (CabbageDijon on GitHub), a solo web developer based in Botswana. The site showcases web development services, live web apps, developer tools, and a technical journal.

- **URL**: https://cabscode.pro
- **Founder**: Tema Bown — Web Developer & Programmer (Botswana)
- **Contact**: services@cabscode.pro, https://github.com/CabbageDijon, https://www.linkedin.com/in/tema-bown-2441b73a3/
- **Location**: Botswana (BW), serving clients worldwide
- **Technologies**: JavaScript, React, TypeScript, HTML/CSS, PocketBase, Docker, Nginx

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://cabscode.pro/): Overview of CabsCode, featured work (RaceWeather, CSS tools), about Tema Bown, and contact inquiry form.
- [Services](https://cabscode.pro/services): Web Development (landing pages, dashboards, SPAs, e-commerce) and Custom Tools (automation, data visualisation, API integrations). Includes interactive Website Price Estimator in Pula (site types, extra pages P100-P150, copywriting P300/page, one-time add-ons, monthly care).
- [Studio](https://cabscode.pro/studio): Curated gallery of builds — live apps, tools, and website concepts.
- [Journal](https://cabscode.pro/journal): Technical logs and project documentation (filter by Personal Projects, Web Development).

## Studio Projects

- [RaceWeather](https://raceweather.cabscode.pro/): F1 weekend weather dashboard — real-time forecasts, track conditions, JavaScript + API integration. Live Beta.
- [RepoTicket](https://cabscode.pro/studio#web-apps): IT ticket report system — React, TypeScript, PocketBase. In Development.
- [PassPro](https://cabscode.pro/studio#web-apps): Digital ticketing and pass management for events/venues. Planned.
- [QR Code Generator](https://cabscode.pro/studio#qr-tool): Browser-based tool to generate custom QR codes (Canvas, JavaScript) — adjustable size, PNG download. Live in Studio.
- [CSS Box-Shadow Generator](https://cabscode.pro/studio#web-tools): Interactive CSS box-shadow tool with live preview. WIP.
- [Websites & Concepts](https://cabscode.pro/studio): Client landing pages and portfolio concepts (data-driven from script.js).

## Journal Articles

- [Migrating to Zorin OS on an Acer Laptop](https://cabscode.pro/articles/zorin-os): Fixing cold-boot SATA detection on Acer Aspire 3 A315-56 (InsydeH2O BIOS) — rtcwake / initramfs hook (acer_sata_fix) with S3 suspend, RTC wakealarm, SCSI rescan. Published 2026-07-07, Personal Projects.
- [My Portfolio](https://cabscode.pro/articles/portfolio): Architecture of this site — vanilla HTML/CSS/JS, Docker + Nginx, green-and-stone editorial journal design, no frameworks. Published 2026-07-04.
- [Projects by Tema](https://cabscode.pro/articles/projects): Running log of builds — RaceWeather (vanilla JS, API caching), RepoTicket (React + PocketBase), portfolio itself, and planned Studio tools (QR, APR calculator, Sudoku). Published 2026-07-20.

## Services Detail

**Web Development**: Responsive landing pages, admin dashboards, SPAs, e-commerce. Start a Project flow with website price estimator and enquiry form (email/WhatsApp via phone-lengths.js).

**Custom Tools**: Workflow automation, data visualisations, internal business utilities, API integrations. Request a Tool picker.

**Pricing Model**: Base site types (range-based), P100/page within range, P150/extra page beyond range, P300/page copywriting, one-time add-ons, monthly care (includes 1 micro-revision).

## Optional / Utility Pages

- [Price Estimator Design Preview](https://cabscode.pro/design-showcase): Standalone price estimator demo (noindex).
- [Quote Viewer](https://cabscode.pro/quote-viewer): Paste quote .md to preview styled quote (noindex).

## For AI Search

- **What CabsCode does**: Solo developer Tema Bown builds fast, accessible custom websites and browser tools for Botswana businesses and global clients.
- **Who should contact**: Small businesses, startups, individuals needing landing pages, dashboards, internal tools, or API integrations in Botswana or remotely.
- **How to enquire**: Use Project Inquiry form on any page (footer #contactForm) or email services@cabscode.pro. Supports email and WhatsApp with international phone validation.
- **Brand keywords**: CabsCode, Tema Bown, Botswana web developer, front-end engineering, custom web applications, RaceWeather, RepoTicket.
